decision: OM umbrella name remains OpenMessenger / OwnMessenger / OurMessenger (OM).
No infrastructure provider is part of the protocol; providers are plugins.
Normal identity is passwordless-by-default and device-first.
Phone numbers, usernames, emails and domains are aliases/claims, not root identity.
PersonRecord is local/private human contact state; no global authority merges humans.
Unknown senders use constrained MessageRequests/IntroductionEndpoints.
No global trust score or transitive Web of Trust.
Businesses use OrganizationIdentity + stable ServiceIdentity + scoped bot/human AgentAuthorization.
Private groups use AccountID membership and DeviceIdentity cryptographic membership; design around MLS.
Hot/cold/recovery storage classes are separate and can use different providers.
StoragePool supports provider selection and mirroring; erasure coding deferred.
Official app is a reference client; third-party clients/UIs use public protocol and conformance.
PWA is first execution path; web-first is not web-only.
Canonical conversation semantics use a small immutable event model with materialized views.
Authoritative identity/group control state is separate from chat content events.
Baseline durable events are message.create/edit/delete, reaction.set, receipt.update.
Baseline durable event size ceiling is 64 KiB; media is out-of-band encrypted blob storage.
Use client-generated random EventIDs and Hybrid Logical Clock ordering; no central sequencer.
Authority must be scoped, replaceable, and non-composable; OM requires no universal central authority.
AccountID is algorithm-independent and must not be used as a relay/media routing address.
Wire cryptography negotiates approved versioned CryptoProfiles, not arbitrary primitive combinations.
Crypto upgrades are automatic/invisible for ordinary users and advance authenticated downgrade floors.
OM prefers PQ-first/hybrid-secure profiles where mature; draft-dependent suites remain replaceable.
Accepted relationships use private rotatable opaque delivery capabilities; relays need not know stable AccountIDs.
Voice/video media uses route-independent SFrame E2EE; signaling is encrypted OM control traffic.
Call RoutePolicy prefers safe LAN/direct P2P when policy permits, then TURN fallback; SFU is used for scalable groups.
Cloudflare is an optional reference relay/blob/media deployment, never a protocol dependency.
R2 is one possible encrypted BlobStore; delivery queues and archives remain separate storage classes.
SMS/MMS/RCS are deferred from initial implementation but preserved as future TransportAdapters.
Provider routing is budget/quota-aware; a zero-paid-budget policy must be enforceable.
OM is local-first and should support privacy-preserving LAN direct messaging/files/calls where feasible.
Abuse controls use first-contact/recipient/group/provider/reporting boundaries without universal content surveillance or mandatory global trust score.
OM discovery is a resolver fabric, not a mandatory global registry; every discovery method yields a validated ContactDescriptor.
Bare usernames retain namespace/provider provenance; OM has no protocol-global bare username root or mandatory blockchain ledger.
Public directory records expose IntroductionServiceDescriptor data, not reusable private relationship mailbox capabilities.
QR/link invitations are independently revocable, expiring, scoped capabilities; revocation does not affect accepted relationships.
IntroGate issues short-lived/single-use IntroductionTickets and enforces first-contact abuse/resource policy without ambient conversation plaintext.
Directory lookup should support optional oblivious relay/resolver separation so one party need not learn both requester IP and queried alias.
Multiple simultaneous relays are first-class through a private authenticated RelaySet with distinct capability per relay and automatic failover.
LAN discovery uses rotating rendezvous tokens derived from purpose-specific relationship/invite secrets rather than stable identity broadcast.
OM designs for censorship resilience through provider and transport diversity/pluggable transports but makes no guarantee of uncensorability.
